WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS seg, y.CustomerID AS cid, SUM(y.Consumption) AS ann
  FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
), mins AS (
  SELECT seg, MIN(ann) AS mn FROM totals GROUP BY seg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT mn FROM mins WHERE seg='SME') - (SELECT mn FROM mins WHERE seg='LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT mn FROM mins WHERE seg='LAM') - (SELECT mn FROM mins WHERE seg='KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT mn FROM mins WHERE seg='KAM') - (SELECT mn FROM mins WHERE seg='SME') AS KAM_minus_SME
